children: France infrastructure private equity firm's 1H 2026 revenue fell 4.5% yr/yr
Company approved interim dividend of €0.28 per share; full-year payout expected stable
Antin expects full-year 2026 dividend distribution to remain stable at €0.71 per share
Company projects 2026 underlying EBITDA to be slightly below 2025 level
Activation of Mid Cap II fund expected in 4Q 2026
MID CAP I STEP-DOWN - Lower management fees due to Mid Cap I moving to post-investment period and charging fees on invested rather than committed capital
LOWER CARRIED INTEREST & INVESTMENT INCOME - Decline in carried interest and investment income contributed to lower revenue
HIGHER OPERATING EXPENSES - Operating expenses rose due to selective hiring, partly offset by cost discipline in other areas
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and 2 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the investment management & fund operators peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Antin Infrastructure Partners SAS is €10.55, about 25.3% above its September 8 closing price of €8.42
The stock recently traded at 13 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 14 three months ago
